messages.subject: Individual Trophic Positions
parts:
Hello!

I used the tRophicPosition package (multiSpeciesTP()) for two crayfish species in a couple of lakes and the results look very good.

My question is: How can I get/extract modeled TPs for each individual in the dataset?
I want  to correlate them with size, for example.

Thank you!

Best
Stefan Linzmaier

I will let you know.

Best wishes,
